notes.text: The f-pawn push attacks the g5 knight but offers 45.Rf3+; White can evacuate the knight via e4 and later take on f6. 44...Rh8 keeps rook activity against h4 and a materially larger advantage. Carlsen lost the game only after a later separate mistake at 52...Ne2+.
